description: This file defines an OpenAI image generation provider, including configuration, helper functions, and the main provider object with image generation and editing capabilities.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for OpenAI API from configuration, defaulting to a constant URL.

methods.name: inferFileExtensionFromMimeType
methods.description: Infers file extension based on MIME type string.

methods.name: toBlobBytes
methods.description: Converts a Buffer to an ArrayBuffer for binary data handling.

methods.name: buildOpenAIImageGenerationProvider
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ImageGenerationProvider object with capabilities and image generation logic.
